text:
You're very welcome, Amelia! I'm glad I could help you cancel those orders and get your refund processed. Your gift card balance should be updated with the $2,460.21 refund right away.

Take care and have a great day! Bye!
zh:
不客气，Amelia！我很高兴能帮你取消那些订单并处理退款。你的礼品卡余额应该会立即更新，包含 $2,460.21 的退款。

保重，祝你今天过得愉快！再见！
